facts.fact: The Presidency states the President inaugurated Gabon's first national and sovereign Data Center in the Nkok special economic zone on 3 July 2026, built by ST Digital, to host data for administrations, businesses and citizens.
facts.system: ST Digital Gabon data centre, Nkok

facts.fact: The Presidency states the ST Digital data centre in Nkok is certified to international Tier III standards, without naming the certifying body.
